record_scope_reconstruction: Two different policy scopes at Singkhon opposite Mawtaung/Mudong: unavailable formal opening and a limited goods-transfer schedule in the claimed border area. Shared crossing-area marker does not equate these policies with universal physical closure.

August 5 meeting reported August 9 still reviews possible reopening; identifies Maw Daung opposite Singkhon.
Official 2024 inspection distinguishes Singkhon control facilities and claimed cargo-transfer space.
Official customs bulletin pairs Singkhon at Khlong Wan with Mudong, Myanmar.
